blocks.text: Setting up your Gmail environment on Mac

Since you cannot download a native Gmail app, the best way to keep it separate from your personal browsing is to create a web app. In Safari, go to File > Add to Dock. This creates a standalone icon in your Dock that behaves like an app. In Chrome, use the three-dot menu > Save and Share > Create Shortcut. This keeps your inbox visible without cluttering your main browser tabs.
Mastering keyboard shortcuts for PR efficiency

PR work requires speed. Gmail shortcuts are disabled by default, so go to Settings > General > Keyboard shortcuts to turn them on. Once active, press ? to see the full list. Use c to compose a new pitch, e to archive after you have filed an inquiry, and r to reply to a journalist. These simple habits save hours of mouse movement over a long week.
Managing media contact lists and pitches

When you manage large media lists, you risk hitting sending limits. A personal Gmail account allows 500 recipients per day, while Workspace accounts allow 2,000. These limits count total recipients across To, CC, and BCC fields. If you exceed these, Google may block your account for 24 hours. Always use a dedicated CRM or email marketing tool for large-scale distribution rather than standard Gmail compose windows.
If you are unsure where a specific setting is located in the Gmail interface, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur. It can point to the exact menu or button you need to click.

blocks.text: Common mistakes in PR email management

Many PR coordinators forget to check their signature after a branding update. Keep your contact details current in Settings > General > Signature. Another common mistake is leaving sensitive client information in the inbox. Archive messages as soon as you have processed them to keep your list clean. Do not let your inbox become your to-do list; use a separate task manager for campaign deliverables.

faq.question: Is there a native Gmail app for Mac?
faq.answer: No, Google does not offer a native Gmail app for macOS. You can create a web app using Safari or Chrome to simulate an app-like experience.

faq.question: How do I speed up my workflow in Gmail?
faq.answer: Enable keyboard shortcuts in your Gmail settings. Using keys like c for compose and e for archive will significantly reduce the time you spend navigating your inbox.

faq.question: What are the Gmail daily sending limits?
faq.answer: Personal accounts can send to 500 recipients per day, while Google Workspace accounts can send to 2,000. This includes all recipients in the To, CC, and BCC fields.
